scripts.build: esbuild client/src/main.ts http4=client/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome120 --sourcemap --outdir=client/dist && esbuild http4-sw=client/src/sw.ts auto=client/src/auto.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome120 --sourcemap --outdir=client/dist && tsc -p client/tsconfig.types.json
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:go && npm run test:wire && npm run test:client && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 $(ls tests/*/*.test.ts | grep -v -e ^tests/client/ -e ^tests/wire/)
